verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents supports calling external APIs/tools that a developer can use to implement RAG ("Call external APIs or lookup data for RAG"), and has full LLM tool-use and MCP integration for wiring in retrieval systems, but there is no built-in knowledge base, document ingestion, or vector-store/RAG pipeline shipped by the framework itself — developers must bring their own RAG implementation via the tools API. Missing for 10: built-in document indexing/vector store, out-of-the-box knowledge-base feature, first-party RAG pipeline or example showing document grounding end-to-end.
